question: Should this PR require real Feishu Open Platform proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the mocked-client/source-level proof for this fallback fix?
rationale: The code shape is narrow and matches the shipped text/card fallback contract, but repository policy treats external channel delivery changes as needing real behavior proof unless maintainers intentionally waive that gap.

options.title: Require real Feishu proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a short recording from a real Feishu setup showing image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal before merge.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: Merge based on helper reuse, regression tests, and source inspection while explicitly owning the remaining live transport uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require real Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a short recording from a real Feishu setup showing image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the existing Feishu reply fallback helper and is the strongest history owner for proof sufficiency on this fallback contract.
